쯤.forms: attached to numbers/time: 세 시쯤 · 열 명쯤 · 일주일쯤
쯤.x: I go home around seven o'clock.
쯤.e: Attach it to numbers and times: 세 시쯤 = around three o'clock.
쯤.t: Attach directly with no space: 세 시쯤, not 세 시 쯤.

귤.x: I eat a lot of tangerines in winter.
귤.t: Jeju Island is famous for 귤.

다.forms: 다 + verb: 다 먹었어요, 다 왔어요

지나다.m: to pass, to go past; (of time) to pass
지나다.ex: 벌써 약속 시간이 십 분이나 지났어요.
지나다.x: It's already ten minutes past our meeting time.
지나다.t: Its modifier gives 지난 'last': 지난주 "last week," 지난달 "last month."

방향.x: Which way do I go for City Hall?

오르다.forms: 올라요 · 올랐어요 · 오를 거예요 · 오르세요 (르 irregular)
오르다.m: to climb, to go up; to rise (prices, temperature)
오르다.ex: 우리는 두 시간 동안 산에 올랐어요.
오르다.x: We climbed the mountain for two hours.
오르다.e: Root of 올라가다 'to go up' and 올리다 'to raise'.
오르다.t: Prices and temperatures rise with 오르다 too: 물가가 올랐어요 'Prices went up.'

초등학교.x: My child started elementary school this year.
초등학교.t: Often shortened to 초등 or 초딩 (slang) in casual talk.

들.ex: 봄이 되면 들에 예쁜 꽃이 많이 피어요.
들.x: When spring comes, lots of pretty flowers bloom in the fields.
들.e: Homonym warning: not the plural ending -들, as in 사람들. Also seen in 들판 and 들꽃.
들.t: 산과 들 (mountains and fields) is a common pairing for the countryside.

탑승하다.m: to board, to get on (a plane, ship, etc.)
탑승하다.ex: 승객 여러분은 지금 비행기에 탑승해 주시기 바랍니다.
탑승하다.x: All passengers, please board the plane now.
탑승하다.t: A formal word for announcements and signs; in everyday talk, people just say 비행기를 타요.

대하다.m: to treat (someone), to deal with; to face
대하다.x: That teacher treats the students kindly.
대하다.e: Literally 'to face'; treating someone is how you face them.
대하다.t: N에 대해(서) means 'about N': 한국 문화에 대해 알고 싶어요.

학습.ex: 이 앱은 단어 학습에 아주 도움이 돼요.
학습.x: This app really helps with learning vocabulary.
학습.t: Pronounced [학씁]; 학습 is formal or academic, while 공부 is the everyday word.

부러워하다.m: to envy, to be envious of
부러워하다.x: My friends were envious of my new phone.
부러워하다.e: From 부럽다 'envious' plus -어하다, used to describe someone else's feeling.

특정.ex: 특정 음식에 알레르기가 있으면 말해 주세요.
특정.x: Please let us know if you're allergic to any particular food.
특정.t: Almost always used right before a noun (특정 사람, 특정 지역); pronounced [특쩡].

생산량.ex: 올해는 비가 많이 와서 쌀 생산량이 줄었어요.
생산량.x: Rice output dropped this year because it rained a lot.
생산량.t: Pronounced [생산냥]: here ㄹ after ㄴ becomes ㄴ.

석방.x: He was released from prison after three years.
석방.t: Pronounced [석빵] — ㅂ becomes tense after ㄱ.

새기다.m: to carve, engrave; to keep in mind
새기다.x: I took my teacher's words deeply to heart.
새기다.t: 마음에 새기다 means to take something to heart.

머리가 복잡하다.m: to have a lot on one's mind, to feel mentally overwhelmed
머리가 복잡하다.x: I've got a lot on my mind these days with so much work.
머리가 복잡하다.e: Literally 'the head is complicated,' with thoughts tangled up.
머리가 복잡하다.t: Pronounced [복짜파다]: tensing, plus ㅂ and ㅎ merging into ㅍ.

직항.x: A direct flight from Incheon to Chicago takes about 13 hours.
직항.t: Pronounced [지캉] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

거리 두기.ex: 거리 두기 때문에 식당이 밤 아홉 시에 문을 닫았어요.
거리 두기.x: Because of social distancing, restaurants closed at 9 p.m.
거리 두기.e: 거리 'distance' (距離) + 두기 'keeping' (from 두다 'to keep, to leave'). Short for 사회적 거리 두기.
거리 두기.t: A COVID-era term: 거리 두기 단계 'distancing level', 거리 두기가 해제되다 'distancing is lifted'. Not to be confused with native 거리 'street'.

방장.m: host/owner of a chat room; head of a room (e.g. in a dormitory)
방장.x: The host invited me to the classmates' group chat.
방장.t: Online, 방장 is whoever created or manages a chat room or game room and can invite or remove members. Offline it means the person in charge of a shared room, e.g. in a dorm.

방영되다.m: to be aired, to be broadcast (on TV)
방영되다.ex: 그 드라마는 매주 금요일 밤에 방영됩니다.
방영되다.x: That drama airs every Friday night.
방영되다.t: 방영 is for TV shows; for radio or general broadcasting use 방송되다.

성희롱.ex: 회사에서는 매년 성희롱 예방 교육을 실시합니다.
성희롱.x: The company holds sexual harassment prevention training every year.
성희롱.t: Pronounced [성히롱]; ㅢ in a syllable that starts with a consonant, like 희, is said as ㅣ.

유유상종.m: birds of a feather flock together
유유상종.x: Birds of a feather, I guess — they both love video games.
유유상종.e: Literally 'each kind follows its own kind'.
유유상종.t: Native equivalent: 끼리끼리; both can sound a little teasing.

본때를 보이다.forms: 본때를 보여요 · 본때를 보였어요 · 본때를 보여 주다
본때를 보이다.m: to teach someone a lesson; to show them who's boss
본때를 보이다.ex: 이번에는 상대 팀에게 본때를 보여 줍시다.
본때를 보이다.x: This time, let's teach the other team a lesson.
본때를 보이다.e: 본때 = a striking display; you 'show' it so others won't forget.

특강.ex: 이번 주 금요일에 취업 특강이 있어요.
특강.x: There's a special lecture on getting a job this Friday.

협주곡.ex: 오늘 밤 공연에서 피아노 협주곡을 연주합니다.
협주곡.x: A piano concerto will be performed at tonight's concert.

짤.x: My friend sent a funny meme to the group chat.
짤.e: Short for 짤방, from 짤림 방지 'preventing deletion': on an early forum, posts without a picture got removed.
짤.t: Casual/online. 움짤 = a GIF (a 'moving' 짤); 짤을 저장하다 = to save a meme.

카르텔.ex: 여러 회사가 카르텔을 만들어 가격을 올렸습니다.
카르텔.x: Several companies formed a cartel and raised prices.
카르텔.e: From German 'Kartell' (English 'cartel'); also used loosely for any closed, self-serving clique.
카르텔.t: For price-fixing, news reports more often use 담합 'collusion.'

초자아.ex: 프로이트는 초자아가 도덕적인 판단을 한다고 설명했어요.
초자아.x: Freud explained that the superego makes moral judgments.
초자아.e: Literally 'the self above the self' — a direct translation of 'superego'.

발사체.ex: 한국은 자체 기술로 만든 발사체를 우주로 쏘아 올렸습니다.
발사체.x: Korea launched a rocket built with its own technology into space.
발사체.e: Literally 'launched body'; -체 = body, object: 발사체, 물체.
발사체.t: Pronounced [발싸체]; in news about missile tests, it also means a fired projectile.

궁색하다.ex: 그는 질문을 받고 궁색한 변명만 늘어놓았어요.
궁색하다.x: When questioned, he just rattled off feeble excuses.
궁색하다.e: Literally 'destitute and blocked': no way out, in money or in words.
궁색하다.t: Two uses: 살림이 궁색하다 'to be hard up' and 궁색한 변명 'a lame excuse'.

푸지다.x: Grandma laid out a generous spread of food.
푸지다.t: 푸짐하다 is the more common everyday synonym.

모티프.x: This novel took an old folktale as its motif.
모티프.e: From French 'motif'; the variant spelling 모티브 is also common.
모티프.t: Collocation: ~을/를 모티프로 하다/삼다 'to be based on ~'.

형사보상.m: criminal compensation for wrongful detention or conviction
형사보상.ex: 무죄 판결을 받은 그는 형사보상을 청구했습니다.
형사보상.x: After being acquitted, he claimed compensation for wrongful detention.
형사보상.e: Literally 'compensation in criminal matters' — the state pays for wrongful imprisonment.
